description: NVIDIA CUTLASS official Ampere tensor-core dense GEMM example (tensorop_gemm.py, CuTe-DSL), run unmodified against sm_89 target shapes, atom_layout_mnk swept at 4096^3
evidence: validate.py-equivalent (per-shape --skip_ref_check=false run): PASS on all 4 target shapes (512/1024/2048/4096) at rtol/atol=1e-2 vs torch.bmm reference. benchmark.csv: at M=N=K=4096, atom_layout_mnk=(2,2,1) achieves 73.43 TFLOPs vs cuBLAS 68.54 TFLOPs = 107.1% of cuBLAS, clearing the >=50% promotion criterion. atom_layout_mnk=(1,1,1) only reaches 9.0% of cuBLAS at the same shape -- confirms atom layout is the dominant tuning knob, as anticipated in the draft's risk section. 512/1024 shapes show >100% of cuBLAS but this is a measurement artifact (cuBLAS launch-overhead-dominated at those sizes, not a real throughput comparison) -- noted, not treated as a result.
